# ICPC contest archive — replay (shard 1)

**This repo is a build output.** Do not edit by hand: everything under `a/` plus
`replay-index.json`, `404.html` and `index.html` is generated by `tools/bake.py` from the
private `archive` repo, and force-pushes may rewrite history on takedowns.

Baked copies of archived ICPC result pages, served via GitHub Pages (from branch, root).
Each page gets a provenance banner, `noindex`, and a `rel=canonical` to its original URL.
Browse via the [contest catalogue](https://icpc-contest-archive.github.io/contests/) —
there is deliberately no index here.

Rebuild: `python3 tools/bake.py` with `../archive` checked out, then copy
`replay-index.json` to `../contests/data/replay-index.json` and rebuild the site.
Shard budget: keep under ~1GB; shard 2 gets created when we approach it.
